edge_case_rules.description: Credit card statements often bill prior-month charges. If a transaction date is in Month M-1 but statement date or payment date is in Month M, reconcile against Month M audit entries.
Legitimate SaaS subscriptions often list 'Autopay ACH Transfer' on bank feeds. Check vendor name before classifying as internal transfer.
Some audit reports list total amount inclusive of VAT/sales tax, whereas invoices show base amount separately. Compare both subtotal and total.
If both a credit card statement line item and a standalone PDF invoice exist for the same transaction, link both to a single canonical expense rather than reporting a duplicate.
